user_query: I'm trying to adopt a more sustainable lifestyle. Can you calculate the carbon footprint of my daily activities and suggest ways to reduce it? Additionally, provide me with guidelines on eco-friendly email marketing practices.

TaskList.description: Gather detailed information about the user's daily activities to assess their carbon footprint.
Calculate the carbon footprint based on the collected activity data.
Analyze the carbon footprint results and identify key areas for reduction.
Generate personalized suggestions and strategies to reduce carbon footprint.
Provide guidelines and best practices for eco-friendly email marketing.
